newsitem.title: INDIA: Uranium deposits found in southern Indian state.
newsitem.headline: Uranium deposits found in southern Indian state.

text.p: Scientists have located uranium deposits in the southern Indian state of Andhra Pradesh, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Monday.
The news agency quoted a science journal, "Current Science", as saying the discovery had opened up a favourable venue for uranium exploration.

"The deposits, containing significant concentrations of the mineral -- 0.55 percent uranium oxide and negligible amounts of thorium oxide -- were discovered in a radioactive quartz rock by the Hyderabad-based atomic minerals division of the department of atomic energy," PTI said.
PTI said the deposits were found in the Palnad sub-basin area in the northern parts of the Cuddapah district of Andhra Pradesh about 300 km (180 miles) from the state capital, Hyderabad.
